{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-ne-o","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"81286175c9d425d7c58ceb3d8ddbb2ff006e77a69328cec842adc2e7698af606","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-ne-class-o:lineage:109","source_registry_sha256":"66161d94cc863d3cf353417f54f101bf8681de71fc4c3b73f43c86f2be1c7398","source_liveness_sha256":"78587b1f8f8617c7b8b0a43b3f0679698b900b7d64ddfc387c1773ac070571e8"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Keeping right, right of way and emergency vehicles","heading":"Keeping right, right of way and emergency vehicles","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Keeping right, right of way and emergency vehicles

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A59
On a multilane controlled-access highway, move at least one travel lane away from a stopped emergency, road-assistance, utility-maintenance, highway-maintenance, waste or recycling vehicle displaying flashing lights. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A59
If traffic or other conditions prevent the required move-over lane change, slow down and pass the stopped vehicle at a safe speed. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A59
The printed road-assistance category includes DOT vehicles, State Patrol motorist assistance, federally registered towing or roadside assistance and utility-company service vehicles. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A59
The handbook lists a first move-over violation as carrying a fine of up to one hundred dollars. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A59
The printed maximum for a later move-over violation is five hundred dollars, seven days in jail, or both. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A59
After a minor interstate or freeway crash with no injuries and drivable vehicles, move to the nearest shoulder out of the traffic lanes. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A59
A vehicle that cannot be moved to the shoulder may be pushed there by law enforcement or removed by others. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A59
When exiting an alley, driveway or parking lot, stop before the sidewalk or sidewalk area and proceed slowly while yielding to pedestrians and approaching traffic. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A59
Yield when an authorized emergency vehicle activates its siren or flashing lights. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A60
For the described moving emergency vehicle, pull parallel and close to the right edge and stop outside intersections unless an officer directs otherwise; opposing traffic across a median need not stop [A60] [A59].
Source: [A60 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec10-R11 | anchor: A59
Stay stopped until the emergency vehicle passes, then check for additional emergency vehicles before moving. [A59]
Source: [A59 -> pdf-0059]
